sources.title: Amergis office directory
evidence: 61 distinct linked office records across 32 states in rendered directory. City, state, ZIP and business telephone available for every record; full addresses require detail pages.

sources.title: MaxView workforce management
evidence: Advertises positions, candidate/credential/bill-rate/schedule visibility, timesheet e-approval, invoice consolidation and quarterly reporting of spend, fill ratios and time to fill.
Advertises a communications hub and notifications of posted jobs to qualified candidates. Features have not been tested in an authenticated tenant.

sources.title: Features of the MaxView Workforce Management Dashboard
evidence: Positions include open/pending and remaining-to-fill counts, comments and attachments. Submittals may be approved or rejected, then tracked through credentialing and active assignments.
Shift statuses named: open, filled, unfilled, canceled. Timecards may be approved/rejected, including by email; guide advertises GPS and QR time capture.

Communication hub, credential document/expiry module and invoice history/status section were future enhancements in this 2024 article. Current exact release status cannot be inferred from the article.

sources.title: Looking for Per Diem Shifts? How MaxView Jobs Can Help
evidence: Filters include start date, shift, location, specialty, pay and duration; alerts may be immediate, daily or weekly.
Applying has two documented branches: an existing compliant candidate is automatically scheduled; a new candidate or one with compliance needs is contacted by a recruiter.
Favorites retain prospective shifts for later comparison. The guide does not disclose compliance rules, simultaneous booking control or cancellation rules.

sources.title: Help Center
evidence: ADP is used for pay stubs, W2s and address updates, with a dedicated support channel.
The Work Number provides automated employment/income verification; written requests or other questions go to a verification team.
Recruiters/local offices support timesheets, compliance training, onboarding, new-hire documents, direct deposit and benefits. Benefits and referral terms can vary by office or position.

sources.title: MaxView Demo Request
evidence: Visible form captures organization, contacts, industry, location, size, current customer/use status, prior demo, features of interest and needs narrative, plus processing consent. No submission.

sources.title: Amergis Contact Us
evidence: Visible routing choices distinguish staffing needs, employee verification, ADP/payroll help, job search and travel job search.
Selecting staffing needs reveals discipline and additional-information fields. Headquarters address is published here. No contact details entered and no submission.
